approvers: Just me; maybe the site foreman and the developer client
reason: I've never seen this used in Malta and I don't pay for window protection today. €19 per m² is real money on a small house job and I'd have to absorb it or argue it with the client. We tape and board the frames ourselves.
objection: Nobody I know has used it here. What if it leaves glue marks or won't peel off properly on my frames after a year of cement and sun, and I'm the one who pays for the damage?
instead: Keep using cheap protection film, tape and cardboard on the frames and being careful on site. Clean the glass at handover.
would_change_my_mind: A local job I can go and see, with a contractor I know vouching for it, and a free test panel on my own frames. The price would also have to be much lower, or the client would have to pay for it.
